name: SubtitleCat
description: Adds subtitlecat.com as a subtitle provider. Searches by the release name of your media file, falls back to title and year, and accepts a subtitle for a different resolution of the same release since the timings match anyway. Machine-translated results are labelled and ranked below native ones.
overview: Subtitles from subtitlecat.com, matched on release name.

versions.changelog: Fixed: the plugin's logo disappeared from Jellyfin's plugin pages after a restart. The running plugin reported its version with four parts (0.3.1.0) while Jellyfin looks the image up by the three-part version from meta.json (0.3.1).

A logo for the plugin, shown in Jellyfin's plugin catalog and on the installed plugins page. Repository changes, no effect on the plugin itself: The release zip now carries logo.png next to the dll and meta.json. logo.svg is the editable source of the logo.

For Jellyfin 12.2. Jellyfin 12 runs on .NET 10 and no longer loads plugins built for 10.11, so this release is rebuilt for it. Servers still on Jellyfin 10.11 should stay on 0.2.0, which remains in the catalog for them. Built for Jellyfin 12.2 and .NET 10 (targetAbi 12.2.0.0). Nothing else changes: the subtitle provider, matching, translation backends and settings behave exactly as in 0.2.0, and existing settings carry over. Repository changes, no effect on the plugin itself: The release workflow reads the target framework and targetAbi from meta.json instead of hard-coding them, and fills the catalog changelog from this file instead of "See the GitHub release notes." Builds use the .NET 10 SDK, pinned through a new global.json.
